<description>
The need for this change was ideated during the review of #34857.

- The node doesn't need to be restarted (with reindex or without) because
rescanblockchain RPC already updates the wallet birthtime, which is the property
that needs to be tested - this allows us to rename the test class to highlight
the change in intention of the test.
- Generate 9 blocks fewer to fund the miner wallet.
- Generate 30 blocks fewer because 20 are sufficient to surpass the wallet
rescan window.
- Use common bumpmocktime helper instead of custom advance_time function.
- Unload miner wallet before 20 blocks generation to avoid notifications from
being processed by that wallet.
- Change the order of arguments in assert_equal for consistency.
- Add few constant and verbose comments for test clarity.

Note: This overhaul helps in reducing the time taken by the test from 2s to 0s as observed in few runs.
</description>

Sorry for the late response, somehow I missed the mail notification from this comment.

It does indeed lose coverage. Try removing the call to `MaybeUpdateBirthTime` in `CWallet:LoadToWallet`. The new version of the test pass while before this commit it fails.
You are right saying that restarting is unneeded, adding just a wallet reload check restores the coverage.
 ```diff
diff --git a/test/functional/wallet_birthtime.py b/test/functional/wallet_birthtime.py
index 4df332b87e..d136307e85 100755
--- a/test/functional/wallet_birthtime.py
+++ b/test/functional/wallet_birthtime.py
@@ -77,7 +77,11 @@ class WalletBirthTimeTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
         # Verify the wallet updated the birth time to the transaction time
         assert_equal(wallet_watch_only.getwalletinfo()['birthtime'], tx_info['time'])

+        # Reload the wallet to verify it reconstructs the birth time from the saved transaction.
         wallet_watch_only.unloadwallet()
+        node.loadwallet('watch_only')
+        assert_equal(wallet_watch_only.gettransaction(tx_id)['confirmations'], TX_CONFIRMATIONS)
+        assert_equal(wallet_watch_only.getwalletinfo()['birthtime'], tx_info['time'])
+        wallet_watch_only.unloadwallet()

     def run_test(self):
         node = self.nodes[0]

```
